As an action, you can lock into total focus for up to a minute, gaining the following benefits for the duration.

  • Once on each of your turns, when you use a maneuver, you can roll a d4 in place of spending a superiority die.
  • Your ability checks and saving throws can't be made with disadvantage.
  • Creatures can't gain advantage on attack rolls against you.

You need a long rest before using this feature again.
